title: Transfer | IV Drug Clearance Curve Fit
goal: Fit a one-compartment concentration-decay model to timestamped plasma samples from an IV bolus study, estimate the elimination constant and half-life, and generate a dosing-clearance summary for a discharge handoff.
skillBenefitRationale: The core challenge is estimating nonlinear decay parameters from experimental concentration data. `curve_fit` is the single critical skill needed to recover the pharmacokinetic constants and derived half-life.
